name: Create and retain a tracker entry
description: Verifies the main tracker workflow saves a valid entry and retains it after a refresh.
steps: Open Tracker from the mobile navigation
Enter horse name Example Runner, race Demo Race 1, stake 10 and decimal odds 3.00
Save the selection
Refresh the page
expected: Example Runner appears in Saved selections after refresh with stake 10.00 and Pending result.

name: Use race tools and understand the calculations
description: Verifies the new race tools provide working arithmetic and clearly labelled educational race information.
steps: Open Race tools from the mobile navigation
Enter decimal odds of 4.00
Confirm implied probability shows 25.0 percent and a $10 return shows $40.00
Enter multi legs 2.00, 3.00 and confirm combined odds show 6.00
Enter a race note and review the speed map and track conditions lessons
expected: The calculator outputs update correctly, notes can be entered, and the page clearly states that race information is educational and not live.

name: Update a result and remove an entry
description: Verifies a saved selection can be settled, included in calculations, and deleted with confirmation.
setup: Create a tracker entry named Settlement Runner with stake 10 and decimal odds 2.00
steps: Change Settlement Runner result to Won
Confirm returns and net result update
Delete Settlement Runner and confirm
Refresh the page
expected: The entry is removed and no longer contributes to tracker totals after refresh.

name: Review insights and handle an unavailable AI service
description: Verifies the Insights lab returns a cautious record review and shows a useful error when the service is unavailable.
steps: Open Insights with no saved tracker entries
Choose Review my record
Wait for the review response
expected: A clear error message explains that insights are temporarily unavailable and that the tracker data remains safe.

name: Use learning, leaderboard, challenges and safer play
description: Verifies the educational area, sample community preview and safer-play tools are accessible on mobile.
steps: Open Learn and select Preview lesson for Reading a form guide
Return Home and inspect the leaderboard
Open Challenges
Open Safer play and review the weekly limit and Australian support links
expected: Lesson preview feedback appears, the leaderboard is labelled SAMPLE DATA, challenge progress is visible, and Australian support resources are accessible.
